title: Cryptographic Algebra, Shannon Secrecy, CRT & Shamir Blueprint
description: An 8-node Lean 4 Blueprint DAG proving algebraic pillars of modern cryptography in pure Lean 4: XOR involution & Shannon one-time pad perfect secrecy, modular ring laws, Chinese Remainder Theorem uniqueness (RSA-CRT), Diffie-Hellman key agreement, and 2-of-n Shamir Lagrange secret recovery.

tasks.title: One-time pad XOR involution on BitVec n
tasks.description: Prove CryptoAlgebra.otp_dec_enc: otpEnc (otpEnc m k) k = m for all n-bit vectors.

tasks.title: Fixed-plaintext OTP encryption is a bijection
tasks.description: Use xor_involution to prove CryptoAlgebra.otp_enc_bijective: fun k => otpEnc m k is bijective on BitVec n.

tasks.title: Shannon one-time pad unique-key secrecy
tasks.description: Use xor_bijection to prove CryptoAlgebra.otp_unique_key: every (m, c) pair has a unique key k with otpEnc m k = c.

tasks.title: Commutativity & associativity of modular addition
tasks.description: Prove CryptoAlgebra.modAdd_comm_assoc for all q, a, b, c : Nat.

tasks.title: Commutative ring laws of modular multiplication
tasks.description: Prove CryptoAlgebra.modMul_comm_assoc_dist (commutativity, associativity, distributivity over modAdd).

tasks.title: Chinese Remainder Theorem uniqueness (RSA-CRT)
tasks.description: Prove CryptoAlgebra.crt_unique_mod_mul: coprime moduli m, n with matching residues imply equality mod m*n.

tasks.title: Diffie-Hellman modular key agreement soundness
tasks.description: Prove CryptoAlgebra.dh_shared_secret_eq: powMod (powMod g a p) b p = powMod (powMod g b p) a p.

tasks.title: 2-of-n Shamir Lagrange secret recovery over Z_q
tasks.description: Combine modular ring laws to prove CryptoAlgebra.shamir_recover_secret: exact secret reconstruction at x = 0.
